---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  as_tibble() |>
  summarize(
    career_hr = sum(HR),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .by = playerID
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_hr, n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Steroid era (1994–2009)",
      "Other eras"
    ),
    player = fct_reorder(player, career_hr)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_hr, y = player, fill = era)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Steroid era (1994–2009)" = "firebrick",
      "Other eras" = "steelblue"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MLB All-Time Career Home Run Leaders",
    subtitle = "Nine of the top fifteen leaders played during 1994–2009",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Career Overlap",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  summarize(
    hr = sum(HR),
    .by = yearID
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds's Home Runs by Season (1986–2007)",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
